areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Direct alignment: integrated sustainable mobility, active-mobility infrastructure, major share of resources, measurable indicators; high impact and technically efficient, innovative solutions.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Socio-environmental management component (tree planting, fauna handling, green-area recovery) with measurable air-quality and active-mobility indicators; relevant but secondary.

areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: Project is urban mobility; resettlement actions do not fit the area's focus on protecting vulnerable groups.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: No actions, indicators or resources linked to risk management; socio-environmental measures are compensatory and legal-compliance actions.

areas.name: Logistics and transport
areas.reason: Area targets air, rail, waterway and cabotage modes; project is urban road transport with no components tied to those modes.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Link is only indirect; intervention is municipal while the area concerns inter-regional disparities.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Community consultation only during project preparation; no structured components for participation, transparency or social control.
